items.headline: Anthropic released Claude Fable 5.2 at $8 per million input tokens, 20% below version 5.1
items.excerpt: Anthropic released Claude Fable 5.2 and Claude Mythos 5.2 on 9 November, priced at $8 per million input tokens and $40 per million output tokens, 20% below version 5.1.

items.headline: Synchopate's llama-modchip runs the 284B DeepSeek-V4-Flash on a 64GB CPU-only machine
items.excerpt: Synchopate released llama-modchip v2.4.0 on 8 November and says it runs DeepSeek-V4-Flash, a 284B-parameter model, on a CPU-only system with 64GB of memory.

items.headline: Ricursive Intelligence released Ripple-65B Preview, an open model scoring 80.52 on TerminalBench 2.1
items.excerpt: Ricursive Intelligence released Ripple-65B Preview, a 65B dense open-weight model under Apache 2.0 that the company says scores 80.52 on TerminalBench 2.1.

items.headline: PSI says its AI system proved the Aaronson-Ambainis conjecture, open since 2008
items.excerpt: Physical Superintelligence (PSI) said on 6 November that its AI system, running a non-public Anthropic model, proved the Aaronson-Ambainis conjecture, a quantum complexity problem open since 2008.

items.headline: OpenAI released GPT-6 Cyber, rated Critical, scoring 48.5% on ExploitGym
items.excerpt: OpenAI released GPT-6 Cyber on 5 November, a security model rated Critical under its Preparedness Framework, which it says scores 48.5% on ExploitGym.

items.headline: OpenAI added GIF creation to ChatGPT with Images 2.6, rolling out to all users
items.excerpt: OpenAI released Images 2.6 on 4 November, adding one-step GIF creation to ChatGPT and Codex, and says its users now generate over 4 billion images a week.
